data.name: Jank Yard
data.detailed_description:
Build it. Jank it. Send it.

Jank Yard is a physics party game about building gloriously bad vehicles and sending them anyway. Snap some bricks together, drag your friends to the start line, and find out whether your creation is a rocket, a wrecking ball, or a pile of parts waiting to happen.

Build any vehicle from bricks

  • Grab a handful of blocks, wheels and bolt-on parts and build whatever you want. A sleek little racer. A six-wheeled monster. A spiked battering ram with a lawn chair on top. There are no wrong answers here, only jank.
  • Snap-and-go building that takes seconds to learn and a lifetime to abuse
  • Wheels, ramps, boosters and wings plus a lot of questionable ideas
  • Your ride carries its own damage, so a rough landing leaves a mark

Then send it

Line up at the start and throw your contraption down the course. Race down giant staircases, launch off massive ramps, stick huge jumps, and try to keep enough of your vehicle bolted together to reach the finish.
  • Wild obstacle courses built for speed, big air and total disaster
  • Real physics, so every crash, bounce and pile-up plays out differently Parts fly off, rides flip, and somebody always eats it at the worst possible moment

Party chaos with friends

  • Jank Yard is best loud and crowded. Hop online, bump your friends off ledges, and settle your grudges head-to-head in a joust, where two rides launch straight at each other and only one drives away. Online multiplayer party game for you and your friends
  • Fast rounds and big comedy moments, easy to pick up and pass the controller
  • Head-to-head joust duels when talking it out is not an option

Make it yours

Dress up your little builder in party hats, crowns, shades and more, then paint your vehicle whatever loud color you want. If you are going to wipe out spectacularly, do it in style.

Build it. Jank it. Send it.
